title: (LEAD) Seoul shares open lower on Democratic Party victory in U.S. midterm elections
caption:
US midterm results sent shockwaves through South Korea’s tech sector. Democratic victories raised worries about tighter AI rules, pulling chip stocks down. The ripple shows how politics abroad can sway Asian markets.
